descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Telecomunicații
Our partner is an international organisation looking to strengthen its Data & Analytics capabilities with a Data Analyst .
 The role combines hands-on data analysis with business partnering . You will work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, turn them into analytics requirements and deliver insights, dashboards and data-driven solutions that support better decision-making.
 You will also collaborate with colleagues across data, technology, automation and AI to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and develop scalable solutions.
 Responsibilities 
 • Partner with business stakeholders to understand their priorities, challenges and analytics needs
 • Translate business requirements into clear analytical questions, KPIs, data requirements and actionable insights
 • Develop and deliver dashboards, analyses, data products and decision-support solutions 
 • Explore, transform and model data to support different business use cases
 • Build and maintain fit-for-purpose datasets, analytical models and business logic
 • Present complex analytical findings in a clear and practical way, turning data into recommendations that support decision-making
 • Identify opportunities for automation, AI and GenAI and collaborate with relevant specialist teams to develop them further
 • Work closely with data engineering, AI and technology teams to ensure solutions are scalable and fit for business use
 • Contribute to the continuous improvement and adoption of analytics solutions across the organization
 The Ideal Candidate has: 
 • 3-5 years of experience in a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst or similar analytics-focused role 
 • Strong hands-on experience with Power BI , Qlik or similar BI and data visualisation tools
 • Strong SQL skills and practical experience with Python for data exploration, transformation, validation and analysis
 • Experience working with datasets, analytical models, KPIs and business insights
 • Good understanding of business processes and the ability to connect data with real business needs
 • Practical experience with cloud-based data platforms , ideally Snowflake 
 • Knowledge of dbt is a plus
 • Familiarity with Power Automate , Power Apps or similar automation tools is an advantage
 • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly
 • A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving, combined with strong business curiosity
 • Interest in data , automation , AI and emerging technologies
